item.name: Research Capsule
item.effect: Advances research on the associated Twisted and grants Ichor when collected.
item.obtainment: Guaranteed on floors; collect a capsule tied to a Twisted.
item.cardSummary: Pick up a capsule to advance Twisted research and gain Ichor during the run.

item.name: Tapes
item.effect: Adds five Tapes to the round counter for elevator-shop purchases and certain Toon abilities.
item.obtainment: Collected during a run; cannot be bought as an item.
item.cardSummary: Round-only currency used to buy items and activate some Toon abilities.

item.name: Stopwatch
item.effect: Widens the skill-check window while extracting a Machine.
item.obtainment: Available only from Dandy's Elevator Shop.
item.cardSummary: A shop-only machine aid that makes extraction skill checks easier for a short time.

item.name: Instructions
item.effect: Boosts extraction speed for a short period while working on a Machine.
item.obtainment: Available only from Dandy's Elevator Shop.
item.cardSummary: A shop-only extraction boost for finishing a Machine faster.

item.name: Extraction Speed Candy
item.effect: Increases extraction speed while working on a Machine.
item.obtainment: Found in floor item pools or bought from Dandy's Elevator Shop.
item.cardSummary: A short machine-speed boost that helps reduce time spent exposed on a floor.

item.name: Skill Check Candy
item.effect: Improves skill-check chance for a limited period.
item.obtainment: Found in floor item pools or bought from Dandy's Elevator Shop.
item.cardSummary: A temporary skill-check boost for players who need a safer extraction window.

item.name: Jumper Cable
item.effect: Adds about one-third of a Machine's progress while extracting.
item.obtainment: Found in floor item pools or bought from Dandy's Elevator Shop.
item.cardSummary: A rare progress boost that can shorten a dangerous Machine interaction.

item.name: Valve
item.effect: Adds nearly all remaining Machine progress instantly while extracting.
item.obtainment: Available only from Dandy's Elevator Shop.
item.cardSummary: A shop-only emergency tool for moving past a Machine with almost no delay.

item.name: Gumballs
item.effect: Each use gives a random 10% stat boost for a short time.
item.obtainment: Found in floor item pools or bought from Dandy's Elevator Shop.
item.cardSummary: Three flexible uses can roll a short boost to help with the next floor problem.

item.name: Chocolate
item.effect: Adds 25 Max Stamina and 10% Walk Speed for a short time.
item.obtainment: Found in floor item pools or bought from Dandy's Elevator Shop.
item.cardSummary: A modest movement and stamina boost for extending a chase escape.

item.name: Stamina Candy
item.effect: Increases stamina regeneration for a short time.
item.obtainment: Found in floor item pools or bought from Dandy's Elevator Shop.
item.cardSummary: Improves stamina recovery so a Toon can reposition or keep running longer.

item.name: Stealth Candy
item.effect: Increases Stealth for a limited time.
item.obtainment: Found in floor item pools or bought from Dandy's Elevator Shop.
item.cardSummary: Temporarily makes a Toon harder for Twisteds to detect.

item.name: Pop
item.effect: Restores 45 Stamina immediately.
item.obtainment: Found in floor item pools or bought from Dandy's Elevator Shop.
item.cardSummary: A quick stamina refill for the moment a chase starts or turns dangerous.

item.name: Speed Candy
item.effect: Increases Walk and Run Speed for a short burst.
item.obtainment: Found in floor item pools or bought from Dandy's Elevator Shop.
item.cardSummary: A short speed burst that can create distance from a pursuing Twisted.

item.name: Protein Bar
item.effect: Greatly increases stamina regeneration for a short time.
item.obtainment: Found in floor item pools or bought from Dandy's Elevator Shop.
item.cardSummary: A strong short-lived recovery boost for rebuilding stamina between chase moments.

item.name: Bottle o' Pop
item.effect: Refills the user's Stamina to full.
item.obtainment: Found in floor item pools or bought from Dandy's Elevator Shop.
item.cardSummary: A full stamina refill reserved for a long chase or a critical escape.

item.name: Box o' Chocolates
item.effect: Adds 25 Max Stamina and 10% Run Speed for a short time.
item.obtainment: Found in floor item pools or bought from Dandy's Elevator Shop.
item.cardSummary: Five uses provide repeated stamina and running-speed help across a difficult run.

item.name: Eject Button
item.effect: Raises Stealth and Walk and Run Speed briefly, and removes the Slow debuff.
item.obtainment: Found in floor item pools or bought from Dandy's Elevator Shop.
item.cardSummary: A high-rarity escape button that clears Slow while giving a short stealth and speed surge.

item.name: Smoke Bomb
item.effect: Briefly breaks a pursuing Twisted's interest and protects the user during the escape window.
item.obtainment: Found in floor item pools or bought from Dandy's Elevator Shop.
item.cardSummary: A short emergency escape window that does not work against Lethal Twisteds.

item.name: Bandage
item.effect: Restores one Heart when used.
item.obtainment: Found in floor item pools or bought from Dandy's Elevator Shop.
item.cardSummary: A compact heal that restores one Heart after a Twisted encounter.

item.name: Air Horn
item.effect: Reduces Stealth briefly and alerts nearby or specific Twisteds to the user's location.
item.obtainment: Found in floor item pools or bought from Dandy's Elevator Shop.
item.cardSummary: A deliberate aggro tool for pulling Twisteds away from teammates or Machines.

item.name: Health Kit
item.effect: Restores Health to the maximum.
item.obtainment: Found in floor item pools or bought from Dandy's Elevator Shop.
item.cardSummary: A full heal for stabilizing a damaged Toon before the next dangerous floor.

item.name: Jawbreaker
item.effect: Grants a random strong effect for a limited time.
item.obtainment: Found in floor item pools or bought from Dandy's Elevator Shop.
item.cardSummary: A random high-value buff that can swing either an extraction or an escape.

item.name: BonBon
item.effect: Increases Extraction Speed and Movement Speed for a short time.
item.obtainment: Granted by Cocoa's ability or by Lost and Found or Blind Grab cards.
item.cardSummary: A rare dual-purpose buff that helps a player finish a Machine and reposition quickly.

item.name: Christmas Cookie
item.effect: Creates a pulse that gives nearby Toons a temporary Movement Speed boost.
item.obtainment: Available from the Christmas event shop or from Lost and Found or Blind Grab cards.
item.cardSummary: A team movement pulse that helps nearby Toons leave a dangerous area together.

item.name: Dandy Easter Egg
item.effect: Creates a pulse that gives nearby Toons a temporary Movement Speed boost.
item.obtainment: Available from the Easter event shop or from Lost and Found or Blind Grab cards.
item.cardSummary: An event-themed team speed pulse for escaping with nearby Toons.
